title: Higher-order function types and callbacks
hook: A higher-order function takes or returns other functions — map, middleware, and debounce are everyday examples. Typing the callback precisely is what separates safe TypeScript from any-sprinkled JavaScript.

blocks.text: A **higher-order function (HOF)** accepts a function as an argument or returns one. TypeScript types the **callback signature** explicitly: `items.map((x: number) => x * 2)`. **Generic HOFs** preserve input/output relationships: `function identity<T>(x: T): T`. Callback types should use **strictFunctionTypes**-safe signatures. At runtime HOFs are plain JS — no wrapper enforces the callback contract.

entries.plainDefinition: Function that operates on other functions.
Function passed to HOF for later invocation.
Type parameter flows from input to output.
entries.example: function map<T, U>(arr: T[], fn: (t: T) => U): U[]

blocks.text: Express `RequestHandler`, React `setState` updater, and `Array.prototype.map` all rely on HOF typing. Loose callbacks (`fn: Function`) hide bugs until runtime. C# uses `Func<>` and `Action<>` delegates — similar intent, nominal delegate types. Senior interviews ask you to implement typed `map` or `debounce` with generics.

blocks.title: Infer when possible
blocks.body: Let generics infer T from array element — avoid redundant type args at call site.

blocks.title: Callback typed as Function
blocks.body: Always use precise signature or generic constrained to function type.

blocks.text: Parameters<T> and ReturnType<T> extract callback shape for wrappers. Overload HOFs for optional callback. Contravariance: Predicate<Animal> not assignable to Predicate<Dog> under strictFunctionTypes. Async HOFs: Promise<T> return. Currying: typed as nested function types or overload chain.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected
blocks.body: Cannot implement generic map. Using Function type. Not knowing Parameters/ReturnType for wrappers.

interviewTakeaways: HOFs take/return functions — type callbacks precisely.
Generics preserve T → U through map/filter pipelines.
Parameters<T> and ReturnType<T> for debounce/throttle wrappers.
60s: Type callbacks not Function. Generic HOF for inference. strictFunctionTypes on params. C# Func parallel. Runtime is plain JS.
commonPitfalls: Weak: cb: Function — disables all checking.
Weak: explicit type args when inference works.
Strong: Generic HOF with (item: T) => U. Parameters/ReturnType for wrappers. Named callback aliases.

jsTsCorrelations.note: JS HOFs are untyped — TS adds callback contracts at compile time only.
Parameters<T> extracts function arg types — essential for typed debounce/partial wrappers.
